title: Nell's Long Trip
checkpoint: Reception Summer 1, week 3 — Phase 4: CCVCC words: two consonant sounds at the start and two at the end (no new sounds)
note_for_grown_ups: This Phase 4 book uses words with blends at both ends, like drink, snack and strong. If a word feels long, split it into chunks and blend the chunks together.

pages.text: Nell had to go on a long trip.
pages.illustration: Nell setting off from the hive behind the sunflowers, the whole meadow spread out ahead of her. Small bee, big landscape, sense of a journey starting.
Aerial view: the pond seen from above with Nell's tiny flight path curving past it. Map-like, showing distance covered.
Nell battling a strong wind, blown sideways off her course, wings straining, grass flattened in waves below her.
Nell landed on a bent stem, wings drooping, visibly worn out. Everything about her posture says tired.

pages.text: She had a sip and a snack.
pages.illustration: Nell drinking from a bead of dew on a leaf and eating a crumb of pollen, restored and content. Close, warm, detailed.

pages.text: Some ants ran up the stem.
pages.illustration: A line of ants marching briskly up the same stem past Nell, single file, ignoring her entirely. Funny and busy.

pages.text: Nell felt glad to be back.
pages.illustration: The hive coming into view over the sunflowers, Nell putting on a burst of speed towards it, sheer relief on her face.

pages.text: It was a long, good trip.
pages.illustration: Closing page: Nell tucked up in the hive entrance at dusk, sunflowers glowing behind, the long journey behind her. Warm gold, deep rest.
